result.finding: The application targets Alpine Linux for containerized production deployment (via eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine base image). Local development is cross-platform: both shell scripts (.sh) for Linux/macOS and Windows command scripts (.cmd) are provided. As a Java/Spring Boot application, it is platform-independent at the JVM level. Azure Container Apps runs Linux containers, so the deployment target OS is Linux.
evidence: scripts/deploy-to-azure.sh: generated Dockerfiles use 'FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine' → Alpine Linux container OS
scripts/*.sh files: shell scripts for Linux/macOS local development
scripts/*.cmd files (startapp.cmd, stopapp.cmd, deploy-to-azure.cmd, cleanup-azure-resources.cmd): Windows CMD scripts for Windows local development
README.md lines 137, 143, 300, 305: explicit Windows and Linux setup instructions
Azure Container Apps deployment target: Linux (Azure Container Apps runs Linux-based containers only)
values: Local development: cross-platform (Linux/macOS via .sh, Windows via .cmd)
JVM: platform-independent (Java 8 source, target Java 21 runtime)
Architecture: linux/amd64 (implied by Azure Container Apps default)
